about: Same spawn as town4_fence_pistol (4 players around Pack-a-Punch, nobody moves, god mode), held for 620 s because the Metal fence sheet showed from ~150 s and the M1911 speckle from ~560 s in long runs. Captures every 2 s from 16-30 s, then every 10 s from 140-610 s; every frame from the first one in play is scored. Zombies keep arriving, so the sheet score past 60 s is calibrated only once a clean long run is blessed into the golden pool.
